name: MingCute Icon
summary: Open-source icon library of 1,663 icons in outline and filled styles, packaged for React, Vue, Svelte and more.
description: MingCute provides 1,663 icons drawn on a 24×24 grid in Core Regular and Core Filled styles with a 2px stroke, for 3,326 styled definitions in total. Icons come as standalone SVG, PNG, WOFF2 icon fonts and framework packages — React, Vue, React Native, Svelte, SolidJS, vanilla JavaScript and web components — plus a Figma plugin and a site where you can adjust color and size before downloading.
contains: 1,663 icons, each in Core Regular and Core Filled styles (3,326 definitions)
icons drawn on a 24×24 grid with 2px stroke
10 packages: React, Vue, React Native, Svelte, SolidJS, vanilla JS, web components, standalone SVG, WOFF2 icon fonts
download SVG or PNG from the site after adjusting color and size
